claim: Probes trained on intermediate activations of an LLM forecaster achieve substantially better calibration than the model's own verbalized confidence, replicating across three different model backbones.
stance_target: internal representations encode more reliable confidence information than verbalized self-report
scope_conditions: forecasting domain (OpenForesight benchmark), Eternis-Forecaster 8B, GLM-4.7-Flash, GLM-4.5-Air
quoted_support: we train representation-pooling probes on intermediate activations and find they achieve substantially better calibration; a result that also holds for GLM-4.7-Flash and GLM-4.5-Air.

claim: Removing an influential evidence source from the prompt often changes the model's forecast while leaving the chain-of-thought reasoning trace textually unchanged, demonstrating CoT unfaithfulness via causal intervention rather than mere self-report inaccuracy.
stance_target: verbalized reasoning is not a faithful account of what actually drives the model's decision
scope_conditions: forecasting domain, evidence ablation and diversionary injection interventions
quoted_support: removing an influential source in the prompt often changes the model's forecast while leaving the reasoning trace untouched.

claim: Probe activations track true behavioral shifts caused by causal interventions far better than the verbalized reasoning trace, predicting the direction of change in 84% of cases including when the CoT conceals the perturbation's influence.
stance_target: probes function as a lie-detector on top of unfaithful verbalization
quoted_support: their activations track behavioral shifts far better than the reasoning trace does, and they also predict the direction of change in 84% of cases, including when the CoT conceals the perturbation's influence.

claim: Forecasts are largely fixed before reasoning begins: a single pre-reasoning activation pass recovers the committed answer and confidence, and routing questions by the spread of this pre-set answer distribution saves 30-47% of generated tokens with no loss of accuracy.
stance_target: probe-derived internal signals convert into a concrete downstream deployment utility (token/cost savings via triage), not just a diagnostic AUROC number
scope_conditions: forecasting domain, forced-answering / pre-reasoning probe experiment
quoted_support: routing questions by the spread of this pre-set answer distribution saves 30-47% of generated tokens, with no loss of accuracy.

claim: The paper positions probing internal representations as a general-purpose practical tool for calibrating, auditing, and triaging language model reasoners, explicitly generalizing beyond forecasting.
stance_target: generality of the probe-based faithfulness-gap framing beyond a single task domain
scope_conditions: stated as a general claim in the abstract, empirically demonstrated only in forecasting
quoted_support: these results establish probing internal representations as a practical tool for calibrating, auditing, and triaging language model forecasters and reasoning models more broadly.
